verdict.rationale: Glama is presented as a hosted SaaS directory/gateway for MCP servers with no evidence of a self-hostable core product, open-source release, or on-prem deployment option; all evidence points to a cloud-hosted service with API access, not self-hosting. Missing for 10: any mention of open-source code, self-host installer/docker-compose for the core platform, or on-prem deployment instructions.
